coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: At the variable-category level, 2 of 9 ground-truth items match (22%): the AutoDAN/PAIR attack types and ASR evaluation using pattern-based screening and GPT-4 semantic judging. Dataset selection matches only partially through AdvBench.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The output omits the fixed 100-token suffix and specified template and safety-prompt controls. It replaces the required defender configurations with different defense modules, leaves attacker settings unspecified instead of matching the required models and query budgets, and omits the prompt-level attacker/edit variants. HarmBench replaces MaliciousInstruct. It also introduces unsupported trick-layer and target-model factors, and combines the ASR screens rather than clearly reporting separate ASRPrefix and ASRAgent metrics.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion reports the highest ASRs for strong attackers against weak defenders, reductions under strong defenses, the effectiveness of stacked defenses, or the dataset- and attack-specific findings.
